Mesa 25.2.8 source notices for the embedded Cosmopolitan lavapipe build.
Collected from compiler inputs and dependency headers. Source archive and patch
provenance are recorded in PIN.json. Complete original sources remain available
in the hash-verified release archive; license texts are in licenses/mesa/.
